results.title: Desku is rated "Excellent" with 4.6 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
I'm thankful to have found Desku when I did. I've been managing my customer support via email and using Trello as a knowledge base. It worked but it's definitely not what I wanted long-term. I transitioned to HelpScout and that was great until my credit card expired while I was in the hospital with covid. I've yet to regain access to all of the data inside of that account so I'm basically starting from what I had in Trello. I love the customization options and although it doesn't natively support it, I'm using it for customer support for my ClickFunnels support. The chat bot works just fine. I can't say that I've encountered any problems that I didn't create and even then the support team were quick to reply to me and solve my problem. It was easy to install, really no heavy lifting and [...] Their support is friendly and responsive.

results.title: Customer Support Software For Gaming Companies | Desku
results.content:
Multiple audiences

### Account Recovery Urgency

When a player loses access to their account, they lose access to everything they have paid for, including skins, progress, in-game currency, and downloadable content (DLC) purchases.  
  
These tickets carry a higher emotional weight than most support requests and need to be resolved quickly. Unresolved account issues quickly turn into public complaints on app store review pages, Reddit threads, and community forums.

Repetitive queries

### Payment and In-Game Purchase Disputes

Subscription billing errors, failed DLC purchases, and refund requests require accurate investigation and a clear, consistent response. In these cases, mishandled payment tickets are among the most likely to escalate publicly and damage player trust at scale. [...] List check icon

Player Reports a Reproducible Crash

A player submits a ticket describing a consistent crash at a specific point in the game. The support agent escalates the issue to the development team’s Slack channel via Desku, including the full ticket context.   
  
 The dev team reviews it, confirms the bug, pushes a fix, and the agent updates the player with a coordinated response, all without a single lost message or redundant email thread.

# Customer Support Software for Gaming Companies | Desku

# Customer Support Software for Game Studios, Mobile Games, and Indie Developers

One AI-powered Inbox for player support – built for gaming teams that need to move fast and stay lean.

Most game studios ship with a small team and a big dream. But the moment your player base grows, the support queue grows with it, and it grows fast.

Account access requests, in-game purchase disputes, installation errors, and bug reports pile up quickly. And unlike large publishers, indie studios and mobile game developers rarely have the support staff to absorb that volume comfortably.
